acceptance_gate: The size lower bound 2^Omega(min(a,b)) for PC and PCR refutations of Tseitin on a x b grids over characteristic other than 2 is proved in prose, with exhaustive and sampled checks of the cut lemma, the isoperimetric lemma, the kill probabilities and a degree sanity check; controls show both conditions of the cut lemma are needed.
objective: Prove the size lower bound by separated-face restrictions (cuts keep a fifth, by planar duality), an explicit balanced-cut tangle in the restricted grid, the tangle lemma of PC-DEGREE-20261020-001B, and constant kill probability with bounded-range independence; check the structural lemmas exhaustively on small grids and the kill probabilities by exact computation and sampling.
status: Proved by PC-SIZE-GRID-20261020-001B-P001 (prose): every PC (0/1 basis) or PCR refutation of the Tseitin formula of the a x b grid over a field of characteristic other than 2 has size 2^(gamma min(a,b) - O(1)), gamma about 1e-6; size 2^O(min(a,b)) poly(ab) suffices, so the bound is tight up to the constant. Method: restrictions deleting non-corner faces at pairwise L-infinity distance >= 3 keep a fifth of every cut (planar duality; sharp), giving an explicit tangle in the connected restricted grid and, by the tangle lemma of PC-DEGREE-20261020-001B, degree about min(a,b)/30; each literal dies with probability 0.0075 with bounded-range independence. Checks exhaustive on small grids and sampled on larger ones; controls show both conditions of the cut lemma are needed. Not found stated after a targeted search; general graphs remain open.
stop_rule: Stop and record the gap if any structural lemma fails on a checked instance.
title: Proof: PC and PCR size of grid Tseitin is 2^Omega(min(a,b))
